description:
Cast Feign Death by paying {B}, targeting Returned Pastcaller.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding {B}.
When Returned Pastcaller dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Feign Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
